title: Early-exit signature comparison in a verification unit
description: Analyze the cycle-level behavior of a byte-serial 16-byte signature comparator RTL module and produce a structured report describing its internal control flow, the relationship between input data and comparison latency, and a concrete remediation that removes any data-dependent timing variation while preserving correct match/mismatch verdicts.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the report correctly identifies the early-exit control signal and the qualitative existence of a data-dependent timing leak.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Fraction of the 17 cycle-count test cases (16 mismatch positions + full match) whose measured cycle count is correctly predicted within tolerance by the reported cycle_relationship formula.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Whether the proposed constant_time_fix contains all required remediation elements (no early exit, full scan, sticky accumulation) without breaking correctness on any of the 17 verdict cases.
